issues.desc: No checklist item explicitly requires defining the gate-consumption query interface (how ProofStory gates query/validate RED records). CHK-001 GREEN definition partially covers this, and W3 owns enforcement wiring, but the spec should define the subsystem boundary that W2 implementation exposes and W3 consumes.

No checklist item addresses the compatibility posture for existing red-evidence.json records in the old self-reported format. The spec should state whether legacy records are grandfathered, migrated, or invalidated — addressable within CHK-003 (supersedes chain) or CHK-004 (retention).
